about_the_game:
Gameplay in the demo does not necessarily reflect the final game.

5th Catacylsm is a JRPG-style Deckbuilder hybrid featuring randomly generated loot, enemies, and a dungeon to explore.

STORY


It takes place on a cursed mountain, which swallows the cities built atop it and grows ever taller. The residual magic of the curse imbues objects with ever greater magical power the longer they are exposed to it, and give greater power the closer to the source those objects reside. 

Delve into the entombed ruins of the old cities, battle creatures of the deep, and find treasures beyond your wildest dreams. Return to the surface to sell off expensive trinkets and fund an even further expedition!

FEATURES

  • Randomly generated cards to find and strategize with.

  • Many enemies to fight with randomly generated attributes.

  • One floor of a dungeon to explore with multiple paths.

  • Shopping!

  • A dungeon crawling twist on the traditional Deckbuilder formula.

  • Knife Snake
